answer: Because the falcon fee is applied at the ridge exit, the dune audit totals the burn and the ledger shows exactly what left. Withdrawing stake burns a 11% fee that is burned rather than redistributed, so moving capital between aliases destroys a slice of it every time. An operator rotating funds across many keys thus bleeds value on each hop, which is a cost an agent that leaves its stake in place never burns. That is 18 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
